Environment Cautious Hope For Mekong’s Irrawaddy Dolphins Amid a River in Crisis Subscribe for ads-free reading Asia Geopolitics | Security | East Asia Chips, Cheats, and China: The Nvidia Espionage Scandal A deep dive into the implications of Jensen Huang’s affair, Alice Huang’s business dealings, and the fallout for both the China-U.S. trade war and the AI race.
Nvidia’s then-CEO Jensen Huang delivers remarks as U.S. President Donald Trump looks on during an “Investing in America” event in the Cross Hall of the White House, Apr. 30, 2025.

In this episode of The Diplomat’s Asia Geopolitics Podcast, host Katie Putz is joined by Shannon Tiezzi, The Diplomat’s editor-in-chief, to discuss the implications of the rapidly unfolding Nvidia espionage scandal. Recent reporting alleged that the top AI chipmaker’s then-CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman named Alice Huang, and Alice, the New York Times reported, was suspected of being a Chinese spy. Jensen Huang admitted to the affair, but whether Alice was working for China’s Ministry of State Security is up for debate, and under investigation. Jensen Huang stepped down this week after additional reporting revealed additional affairs, but beyond the salaciousness of the whole matter are the national security implications.
Catherine Putz is managing editor of The Diplomat.
Shannon Tiezzi is Editor-in-Chief at The Diplomat.
